facts.fact: Defimedia reports that the 2025-2029 Government Programme announced a Freedom of Information Act and that none of the transparency measures including it has been achieved so far.

MUS.note: The document says nothing on digital-skills training for civil servants.
The document says nothing on a national data policy.

facts.fact: Defimedia lists an Electronic Transactions (Amendment) Act among the 17 laws adopted so far in 2026, with no commencement date given.

MUS.note: The only consultation named, on the Child Adoption Bill, is not said to have run online.
The document says nothing on open data.
The document says nothing on data published for download.
The consultations named are on non-digital bills; nothing on a digital law or policy.
